current.text: Charlotte got Allen from Phoenix in the Miles Bridges trade.
His Yahoo status is questionable with a knee issue.
He is projected as Charlotte's sixth man, and he starts while Kon Knueppel is out.
Charlotte is short on healthy players. Kon Knueppel is hurt and Coby White is out with a calf injury.
Experts expect a smaller role than he had in Phoenix. He is a bench player in Charlotte, but he would start if Brandon Miller misses games.
His shot volume should drop from last season's outlier level. Experts expect his efficiency to recover, and he should help as a secondary creator off the bench.
He is a late-round swing with a low ceiling. One expert says Yahoo ranks him too low at 160 and puts him at 100 to 115 (rounds 10 to 11), but warns not to push his price much.
The newest mock draft sees him as most useful in the short term, while Charlotte's injured guards are out.
Charlotte has 13 back-to-backs, the league minimum. Its playoff schedule is 4-3-4 games for a March 28 end. One other note mentions a two-game playoff week.
Charlotte plans to space the floor and take many threes. Playmaking will be spread across several players, with no single primary creator.

durable.text: He can play the two, three and four, and he can handle the ball.
He plays bigger than his size and drives downhill, and that has worn his body down.
He is older and has soft tissue problems, so experts see a real injury risk. One expert thinks he has peaked and is in the back nine of his career.
Threes are his best category, with useful FT% and steals. FG% is his weak spot for his position.

note: Both sites price him at 0 USD (Yahoo rank 180, ESPN rank 158), and he was not drafted in our league. Only 144 players get drafted, so he is a 1 USD end-of-draft pick at most, even though one expert puts him around 100 to 115. He fits punt FG% builds that want threes, FT% and steals. Early on, check his knee (Yahoo Q), whether he starts while Knueppel and White are out, and whether his FG% recovers on lower volume. If he loses his starting spot, he is easy to drop.
